newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares fall on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares fall on political uncertainty.

text.p: Istanbul shares continued to fall amid uncertainty over the fate of Turkey's Islamist-led coalition government in early trade on Monday morning, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 which brushed a low of 1,414, stood at 1,416 at 0753 GMT, down 27 points, or 1.87 percent from Friday's close.
"The market is completely indexed to politics. Direction will depend on news to come from Ankara. Trade is extremely dull and thin," said Nadir Erturk from Can securities.
Former minister Yalim Erez stepped up his campaign late last week to forge a secularist alliance to replace Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's divided coalition.

Erez, from the coalition's conservative wing, had been trying to build support for a secularist pact since he resigned in late April over the ruling Islamists' reluctance to comply with army demands for a crackdown on rising Islamist activism.
